finding: guard-human-fields refuses a Write of a finding file when the body quotes a human field at the start of a line, for example a fenced YAML block that holds `override_by: human`. The YAML_LINE pattern scans the whole text, not only the frontmatter, so _yaml_values reads a body line as a field. An agent that files a finding about a waiver gets the message that it sets a human field. Reproduced with a Write payload whose frontmatter is clean and whose body holds the fenced block: exit 2, expected exit 0. Fix: in _yaml_values, read only the lines between the two frontmatter delimiters.
why_this_severity: The guard still refuses every real write of a human field, and an agent can quote the field inline or indented to file the finding (no to fails_purpose). The refusal message is false for this call, so the agent must find out why it was refused.
